threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'bus stop' instead of a 'bus shelter'—everyone knows that's where the drama unfolds.
Caught the N63 last night; a guy in full suit was singing opera to a bemused crowd. Only in Brixton, right? The bus felt like a stage.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the U-Bahn was shut down for days, but I still heard a saxophonist jamming near the station. That's when I felt the true spirit of Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find techno clubs tucked inside former wedding halls, where the bass thumps louder than the vows ever did.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to avoid the BART at rush hour after overheated brakes. Tourists look puzzled while we swap stories about delays like it's normal.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy playing the accordion on the 30 Stockton this morning, completely drowned out by a toddler's tantrum. Classic San Francisco chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just for partying; they miss the real treasure—those tiny art studios hidden behind unmarked doors.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their aversion to the 'hola' with eye contact; locals know it’s all about the nod while walking by.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the tube like you’re at a bus stop, not realizing they come by every 2 minutes. The locals just glide in and out.
Caught a whiff of jerk chicken at 2 AM on the 59. Always a party at the bus stop, but the mix of spice and late-night chatter felt particularly alive last night.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a kid in the park asking his dad why the pigeons were always 'so funky'—that’s when I knew this place had its own vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find spontaneous street karaoke in the middle of a Kreuzberg market—one minute it's a hustle, the next, it turns into a concert.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they can tell you the difference between a ‘café con leche’ and a ‘latte’ just by looking at the foam.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tux on the 31 line, holding a bouquet. He looked nervous but the ride was smooth. Only in SF, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always think Gràcia is just for hipsters, but it’s the local bakery on Carrer de Fraternitat that keeps the neighborhood alive with scents of fresh pa amb tomàquet.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their confusion over the ‘tobacco’ shops—looking for cigars, but just finding paper and stamps.
